evals.prompt: I'm about to hand off the new savings goal screens in Figma. What should I check?
evals.expected_output: A pre-handoff checklist and steps: libraries, modes, instances not detached, variables bound, states, themes, copy, accessibility annotations, compliance review, Section marked Ready for dev.
expectations: Requires all fills, strokes, radius and spacing bound to variables
Requires light and dark (and PF if relevant) checks
Requires no detached instances and [gap] for missing components
Ends with marking the Section Ready for dev and a handoff note
